ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: Matter delivery, Opening and later stages need Responsible partner and Matter manager.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(CASE(Stage__c, "Opening", 1, "Cleared to start", 2, "In progress", 3, "Awaiting client", 4, "Final billing", 5, "Closed", 6, 0) >= 1, OR(ISBLANK(Responsible_partner__c), ISBLANK(Matter_manager__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Responsible partner and Matter manager before moving to Opening.
